$comment: PrismCraft block-format manifest. Machine-readable registry of the voxel cell encoding and every block-texture atlas layout. Human companion: block_formats.md. Source of truth in code: scripts/cell_types.gd (validate_block_texture, encoders) and scripts/shape_builder.gd (geometry).

block.note: block mode is 32x32x32; grid_y shown as 32 for a single block

prism.note: PRISM cells are right-isosceles (45-degree). A prism has 5 faces (2 caps, 2 legs, 1 hypotenuse); each maps to a distinct cell face slot via slot_for_normal (Y>X>Z precedence, collision-free for all 12 orientations), so a prism can carry a separate color per side. Uniform prisms (all slots equal, as the shape importers produce) render as one color.

corner.note: corner names the position of the prism's solid right-angle in the cross-section plane

rgb5551.flag_bit: 0x10000 set on the stored int to mark 5551 format

color.routing_rule: If any source pixel has alpha < 255 the texture is treated as transparent and every cell packs to RGB5551 (alpha_bit = source_alpha >= 128 ? 1 : 0); otherwise all cells pack to RGB565.
color.render_rule: Cutout cells alpha-test in the fragment shader (discard when alpha < 0.5), render double-sided, and never occlude neighboring faces.

import_rule: Strict 1:1: one texel maps to exactly one voxel face, nearest-neighbor, never scaled/filtered/padded/cropped. A texture whose (width,height) does not exactly match a registry entry is rejected with a warning and nothing is imported.

formats.name: uniform
formats.atlas: single 32x32 cell applied to all 6 faces

formats.name: capped
formats.atlas: left 32x32 = 4 sides; right 32x32 = shared top+bottom cap

formats.name: octagon_full
formats.geometry: extruded octagon, footprint 32, chamfer c=9 (axis faces 14, diagonal faces 9), 4 diagonal corners are prism cells
formats.atlas: side strip widths [14,9,14,9,14,9,14,9] CCW from +X (E,NE,N,NW,W,SW,S,SE) then a 32x32 shared cap
formats.texturing_note: corner-prism top/bottom triangles take the cap design (same indexing as the adjacent solids); their lateral faces take the diagonal strip

formats.name: octagon_half
formats.geometry: extruded octagon, footprint 16 centered in the 32 block (8-voxel empty margins), chamfer c=5 (axis 6, diagonal 5)
formats.atlas: side strip widths [6,5,6,5,6,5,6,5] then a 16x16 cap
formats.texturing_note: corner-prism top/bottom triangles take the cap design (same indexing as the adjacent solids); their lateral faces take the diagonal strip

formats.name: diamond
formats.geometry: diamond column: chamfer c=16 (axis faces vanish), 4 diagonal 45-degree faces, corners are prism cells
formats.atlas: cols 0-63 = 4 diagonal faces x16 (CCW from +X-facing NE); cols 64-95 = 32x32 cap
formats.texturing_note: corner-prism top/bottom triangles take the cap design (same indexing as the adjacent solids); their lateral faces take the diagonal strip

formats.name: chamfered
formats.geometry: cube with 4 vertical edges chamfered, c=4 (axis faces 24, chamfer faces 4)
formats.texturing_note: corner-prism top/bottom triangles take the cap design (same indexing as the adjacent solids); their lateral faces take the chamfer strip

formats.name: cross
formats.geometry: plus/cross column, pure cubes: central 16x16 + four arms 16 wide x 8 deep (CROSS_ARM=16, CROSS_DEPTH=8)
formats.texturing_note: caps and all 12 side faces textured 1:1; cols 0-127 map onto the unrolled perimeter (CCW from +X arm end), cols 128-159 onto the caps

formats.name: ramp
formats.geometry: 45-degree wedge, one prism cell per step (Z-axis prism ori 9 on the slope), extruded along Z
formats.atlas: row1 (y0-31): slope(32) | back(32) | bottom(32) | unused(32); row2 (y32-63): side-L(32) | side-R(32) | unused

formats.name: gable
formats.geometry: two 45-degree slopes meeting at a centered ridge, half-height (ridge at y=16); left slope prism ori 9, right slope ori 8
formats.atlas: row1 (y0-15): slope-A(32) | slope-B(32) | end-A(32) | end-B(32), each 32x16; row2 (y16-47): bottom 32x32

formats.name: diagwall
formats.geometry: diagonal wall band along the NE-SW diagonal, thickness DIAGWALL_T=8, full height; prism cells on both long faces (ori 3 lower-right, ori 1 upper-left)
formats.atlas: wall-A(0-31) | wall-B(32-63) | end-A 8x32(64-71) | end-B 8x32(72-79) | top+bottom ribbon block(80-111; rows 0-7 top plan, rows 8-15 bottom plan)
formats.texturing_note: walls 1:1 on the boundary prisms; top/bottom sample the ribbon plan (u = along-wall (x+z)/2, v = across-thickness (x-z+7)/2, bottom mirrored across thickness); ends 1:1 at the footprint borders (end-A = SW, end-B = NE, u = across-thickness, NE mirrored so both read facing outward); prism caps take the ribbon, prism hypotenuses keep the wall sample

formats.name: opening
formats.geometry: cube with ONE top edge chamfered 45-degree, depth OPENING_CHAMFER=8; bevel is an X-axis prism ori 4
formats.atlas: seven 32-wide cells: front(0-23 rows) | chamfer(0-7) | top(0-23) | back | bottom | side-L | side-R
formats.texturing_note: front/chamfer/top/back/bottom and both pentagonal side faces textured 1:1 (side-R u = z; side-L mirrored so both read upright facing outward; the bevel prism's +-X caps sample the same side cells)

formats.name: panel
formats.geometry: flat cube 32x32x1, flush to one face
formats.atlas: row1 (y0-31): top(32) | bottom(32); y32: N|S (32x1 each); y33: E|W (32x1 each)

formats.name: slab_quarter
formats.geometry: flat cube 32x32x8, flush to one face

formats.name: slab_half
formats.geometry: flat cube 32x32x16, flush to one face

formats.name: stairs_2
formats.geometry: solid staircase, 2 steps of 16 voxels, extruded along Z (like the ramp)
formats.atlas: single row: tread(16) | riser(16) | back(32) | bottom(32) | side(32)
formats.texturing_note: tread cell is a plan view of one step strip (u = x within step, 0 = riser edge; v = F-1-z, north-up like slab tops); riser cell is the riser elevation rotated 90 degrees (u = height within the step, 0 = bottom; v = z)

formats.name: stairs_4
formats.geometry: solid staircase, 4 steps of 8 voxels, extruded along Z
formats.atlas: row1 (y0-31): tread(8) | riser(8) | back(32) | bottom(32); row2 (y32-63): side(32) | unused(48)
formats.note: uses a two-row layout because the single-row width (112) would collide with diagwall
formats.texturing_note: tread cell is a plan view of one step strip (u = x within step, 0 = riser edge; v = F-1-z, north-up like slab tops); riser cell is the riser elevation rotated 90 degrees (u = height within the step, 0 = bottom; v = z)

formats.name: pipe_quarter
formats.geometry: one 32x32 quadrant of a 64x64 hollow octagonal ring (outer octagon chamfer 19, bore octagon inset 2 chamfer 19; axis walls 2 voxels, diagonal walls ~2.8 voxels with prism cells on BOTH surfaces), extruded along Y. Four Y-rotations close one ring.
formats.texturing_note: caps and interior fill from the end-ring cell; outer/inner arcs map 1:1 along the unrolled quadrant perimeters (outer: 13 flat + 19 diagonal + 13 flat = 45 columns; bore: 11+19+11 = 41), diagonal runs painting the prisms' hypotenuse faces; walks run in one rotational direction so four rotations tile continuously; the 2-wide cut cell is reserved (cut faces use fill)

rejected: Any (width,height) not listed above -> warning names the received size and the nearest legal sizes; nothing is imported. No code path resamples, filters, pads, or crops a block texture.
